title: Grateful Dead Live at Baltimore Civic Center on 1982-04-19
lineage: SBD Master Cassette > R1 7.5ips 1/4 track > Technics RS-1506 > Grace designs Lunatec V3 (pre only) > Korg MR-1000 > DSD-DFF 1bit 5.64 Mhz > Audio Gate SW > 24/96 WAV

ai_review.summary: Audience tape of the famed Raven/Space show suffers from a mid‑song cut‑out and tapers’ chatter, making it a poor recording despite the historic performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience source that captures the legendary "Raven" space segment, but it is marred by a noticeable drop‑out in the middle of "Good Lovin'" and background conversation from the tapers. While the show itself is historically significant, the technical flaws limit its listenability.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, rating of 0 stars and clear complaints about recording problems outweigh any positive note on the show's historic nature.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with tapers' discussion audible; cuts out in the middle of "Good Lovin'"; overall limited clarity and fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing; reviewer focuses on recording issues rather than musical flow.

band_member_comments.Phil: Reviewer notes Phil left the night before, implying his bass presence was missing or reduced.
